title: Property-by-property field compatibility
description: Existing SharePoint field compatibility is not classified property by property.
rationale: A successful GET does not prove a field matches every contracted property.
remediation: Compare every contracted field property and classify MATCH, CREATE_MISSING, INCOMPATIBLE, or GET_FAILED without in-place coercion.

residualGate.description: Current field properties and any approved migration remain tenant evidence.
